For Vision's screensaver to start on its own, choose “Vision” as the screen saver in the TV settings (often: Display, then Screen saver).

Some TVs (TCL, Google TV) hide this option. Then there are two ways: an administrator sets it remotely (ADB), or Vision starts its own screensaver when its home screen goes without the remote for a while (adjustable in Vision settings). It goes away at the first button press, and never covers another app.
